_comment: Engine hubs. One page per engine is generated to workshops/engine-<id>.html from this config joined with content/workshops.json. Every workshop id appears in exactly one section, so nothing is repeated on the page. Sections are ordered top to bottom; install=true marks a section that needs the free desktop app, install=false marks one that runs in the browser with nothing to install. titles, links, difficulty and age always come from the workshop data. Add an engine block and run: node scripts/generate-engine-hubs.js

engines.name: Blender
engines.tagline: A free 3D toolkit for modelling, materials, rigging and animation.
engines.lumo: Start with your first cube scene, then follow the My First 3D Model episodes, one skill at a time.
engines.pip: Model it, light it, animate it. Take it one step at a time and it all adds up.
engines.install: Blender is a free download and needs no account. The Mod Studio runs in the browser.

ladder.title: Stage 1: Learn Blender
ladder.note: The nine-step beginners course. Finish with a simple rendered scene. Next: Episode 1, then build a character.

ladder.title: Stage 2: Build a character
ladder.note: Episode 2 models a low-poly character. Start with Episode 1 if the viewport still feels new. You need to move, rotate and scale objects.

ladder.title: Stage 3: Rig and animate
ladder.note: Episode 3 adds bones and weights, then Episode 4 animates a walk cycle. You need a finished character mesh.

ladder.title: Stage 4: Create a scene
ladder.note: Episodes 5 to 7 add materials, lighting and a complete rendered scene. You need a rigged, animated character.

ladder.title: Stage 5: Independent project
ladder.note: Build your own scene from a brief. Use the episode skills and the browser Mod Studio to plan it. You need modelling, rigging, animation, materials and lighting.

checkpoint.title: Ready for the next course?
checkpoint.blurb: Tick what you can already do. We will point you to the next workshop and name the skill it expects.
skills: Move, rotate and scale objects in Blender.
Model a simple character from primitives.
Rig a character with bones and weights.
Animate a walk cycle with keyframes.
Add materials and textures to a model.
Light a scene and render a finished picture.
Build a complete scene from start to finish.

steps.label: Open Blender Beginners
steps.text: Start with Stage 1: Blender Beginners. The nine-step course needs no experience.

steps.label: Open Episode 2: character
steps.text: Next: Episode 2 builds a low-poly character. Episode 1 is a short cube warm-up if the viewport still feels new.

steps.label: Open Episode 3: rigging
steps.text: Next: Episode 3 adds bones and weights to your character.

steps.label: Open Episode 4: animation
steps.text: Next: Episode 4 animates a walk cycle with keyframes.

steps.label: Open Episode 5: materials
steps.text: Next: Episode 5 adds materials and textures.

steps.label: Open Episode 6: lighting
steps.text: Next: Episode 6 lights the scene and sets the mood.

steps.label: Open Episode 7: complete scene
steps.text: Next: Episode 7 brings the model, animation, materials and lighting into one scene.

steps.label: Start an independent project
steps.text: You are ready for Stage 5: an independent project. Choose a brief and build your own scene.
